findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_whale_trades, get_trader_profile, get_trader_positions, get_market_news · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_leaderboard, get_trader_profile, get_trader_positions · Public sink: get_market_movers, get_trending_markets, get_market_flow, get_leaderboard, get_market_news · Destructive: get_market_flow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_whale_trades, get_trader_profile, get_trader_positions, get_market_news · Private data: get_whale_trades, get_leaderboard, get_trader_profile, get_trader_positions · Public sink: get_market_movers, get_trending_markets, get_market_flow, get_leaderboard, get_market_news · Destructive: get_market_flow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
